implementation_scope.purpose: Add the missing repository machinery to reconcile exact accepted M5 capture identities and intervals against eligible mean-reversion development scopes, quantify overlap, and produce an outcome-blind disjoint-cohort/data-scope proposal.
requirements: Bind inputs to accepted capture and freeze artifacts; verify exact identities, symbol names, intervals, resolution, and provenance.
Use only currently eligible, EUR200-feasible universe authority and non-outcome selection features; do not treat the 41 topology representatives as economic or inferential equivalents.
Report reusable accepted coverage, missing coverage, and the smallest disjoint increment that meets prospectively declared data and effective-sample-size requirements.
Do not compute strategy events, response statistics, returns, PnL, or economic outcomes; do not request data for any exact cohort already listed as blocked.
Record exclusions and all scope alternatives; do not rerun opened identities or use protected/forward evidence.
Do not run a parameter surface. Any subsequent tunable-mechanism development requires a separate prospective freeze under the parameter governor.
implementation_scope.scope_output: Non-economic audit and proposed prospective cohort/data scope only; no acquisition or economic experiment is authorized by this proposal.

decision.rationale: Continue from the latest mean-reversion preflight with a non-economic scope audit. Do not rerun the Epoch42 diagnostic, compute strategy response statistics, or use observed winners to select symbols. The exact blocked cross-sectional cohort is not reused; breakout and trend alternatives have recent structural work or unresolved transport integrity, respectively.

universe_methodology.selection_rule: Select and freeze any cohort only after the exact accepted-scope audit, using the listed non-outcome features and eligible-universe authority; no per-symbol strategy outcomes or topology representatives as substitutes.

next_research_state.implementation_scope: Create the scope-reconciliation and outcome-blind disjoint-cohort selection machinery specified in decision. No exact deterministic operation is authorized in the current epoch catalog. Do not acquire market data, compute strategy responses, or open an economic outcome.

objective.goal: Reconcile accepted mean-reversion capture scopes and determine whether a minimal, genuinely disjoint development-data increment is needed.
objective.information_gain_rationale: Epoch43 established a power-aware preflight but did not authorize an outcome test. Resolving exact capture overlap and feasible breadth identifies whether existing accepted data can support a prospectively selected cohort, avoiding both redundant acquisition and reuse of an inadequate structural panel.
